description: The run detail page's Extraction result grid, rendered headlessly from the task's buggy build (real grid components and the app's own stylesheets and dark palette) with a run shaped like the upstream issue's: three results of one test case, the first two without a score. The header (red outline: group-label row and column-label row) shows uppercase, letter-spaced labels of mixed sizes ('TEST CASE NAME', '# RUN NUM...', 'TOTAL TURNS'), the SCORE and EXACT_MATCH labels sitting at the left of their columns while the values sit at the right, and the metric group labels ('DeepEval: Answer Releva...', 'Exact Match') lighter than 'Execution' and 'Extracted'. Replaces the upstream attachment, which predated the injected defects.

description: The 'Execution Results' grid on a Run Comparison page, grouped into 'Execution' and per-metric column groups with two numbered sub-columns (two runs) plus a 'Delta' column. Header labels are small, sentence-case and semibold, in the same weight as the column group labels above them. This is the existing, correctly styled sibling grid the Extraction result grid (current.png) is meant to visually match.
